rows.en: One of the Hakkeshu... Shi-Tau. I'll be your opponent!
This place will be your grave!
You fools who defy the Tekkoryu... Vanish!
rows.notes: Glossary 'Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon)' shortened to 'Tekkoryu' for a shouted line.

rows.en: Gallowin of the Waters, here I come!
Don't underestimate... the power of Water.
I'm making my move! Gallowin, full power!
I'll wipe out the Kihara bloodline... right here!!
Don't you dare think Water is inferior to Heaven!!
Zeorymer! I'll reduce you to dust!!
That softness... will be the death of you!
Intercepting! You'd better brace yourself!
You're that relaxed against me... Are you mocking me!?
You'll pay for scorning Water... with your own body!!
You dare lay a hand on my Gallowin...!
Defying the Hakkeshu... You must have a death wish.
Impossible! Gallowin of the Waters! And me, too!?
Sister... I...
A direct hit!? Impossible!
I'm not dead yet...!
I underestimated the enemy...!? How could I!
Gallowin! Hold out a little longer!!
Even with the power of Water... I'm pushed this far!?
I, Shi-Tau... won't go down for nothing!!
Masaki Kihara! You, of all people...!!
So this is the greatest power of all the Hakke robots...!!
Things are finally getting interesting.
You have to be at least this good, or there's no point fighting!
Looks like I can finally get serious.
To do this much against Water...!!
You're doing well against my Gallowin...!
You seem to have some power, but...!!
Is this your limit!? Zeorymer!!
So Heaven is just a name after all!!
You fool, you don't know your place...!
...Did you just do something?
I'll give you credit for hitting Water.
You're no match for the Gallowin!
That's not enough to make me get serious.
Masaki Kihara...! Are you mocking me!?
Zeorymer of the Heavens... So this is all you are!
You should aim more carefully.
Are you toying with me...!?
I can't afford to get hit!
Heh... your aim is sloppy.
Even Heaven is powerless before Water!!
rows.notes: Source trails off ('even Heaven, before Water...!!'); verb restored.

rows.en: That won't work on me!
That won't work on the Gallowin of the Waters!
My output... is dropping...!?
You're hitting Water's blind spot...!
rows.notes: Out-of-range line: enemy attacking from where Water can't strike back.

rows.en: Gallowin of the Waters, following up!
I'll be taking the finishing blow!
Sister! Get out of my line of fire!
I won't let you!
What a handful you are!
How dare you run wild in front of Water!
Sister, you're too far forward!
Gallowin Blizzaaaaard!
Gallowin Blizzard! Disappear!!
Mega Searcher Beeeeeam!
Go on, try to escape the Mega Searcher!
There! Mega Searcher Beam, fire!
Take this! The roar of the wind!
Wind! Rage on!
I'll blow you away! That's all there is to it!
Don't think you can block the wind's path!
I'll make you feel the power of my Lanstar!
Masaki Kihara...! You, of all people...!
Laying a hand on Wind... How foolish!
Damn youuu!
I've seen through your moves!
If you get in Wind's way, you'll simply vanish!
Nnngh...! I can't lose this battle... I can't lose, and yet!
Uwoooh!? Th-this can't be!
Yuratei... I...!
Even with the power of Wind... this is the end!?
Until the very last moment... I won't give up...!
For the sake of my love... I cannot lose...!
Don't fall, Lanstar! I can't... end it yet!
...You must be enjoying this, Kihara. But... it's too soon!
Ugh...! Not bad!
Without that, there'd be no challenge!
You're better than I thought!
Heh, this is how a battle should be.
It's not over yet!
The Lanstar of the Winds can still move! Come on!
Not yet, it's too soon to laugh, Kihara!
That was nothing!
Oh, your aim seems true.
You hit my Lanstar. Interesting...!
Heh... You challenge Wind with only that?
You seem to be taking the Lanstar of the Winds lightly.
And with this you call yourself the strongest Hakke!
rows.notes: Aimed at Zeorymer (strongest of the Hakke robots).

rows.en: I'm here! Right here!
Heh... You think you can hit the Lanstar of the Winds? ...Laughable...!
Masaki Kihara... are you mocking me!?
I don't even need to dodge!
You can't get through the wall of wind...!
Impossible... I can't attack...!?
From outside the Lanstar's range!? Nnngh...!
Move! I, Taiha, will finish this!
The Lanstar will take this one!
The Lanstar of the Winds can block it!
Get back! You're in the way!
This is what real aiming looks like!
Lanstar, give them a little scare!
Go! Booonefoooon!
Deeeyaaah!
Lanstar of the Winds, full power!
Be blown away by the Bonefoon!
Take the strongest attack of my Lanstar of the Winds!
Deaaad! Long! Fuuuuun!
uncertain: Attack name 'Dead Long Fuun' (Lanstar finisher) is not in the glossary; romanized from kana. Please verify on akurasu.

rows.en: Behold the power of the moonlight!
Vanish in the moonlight!
Feel the power of this Rose C'est La Vie!
Before the light of the moon... all are powerless!
Shatter! Before the light of the moon!
I will destroy... the Zeorymer that Masaki Kihara built!
If you can hear my voice, know that bearing Masaki Kihara's blood is your sin!
I've waited...! I've waited for this moment alone!
If you can hear my voice, know that bearing Masaki Kihara's blood is your sin!
rows.notes: Same line as q08730 with a different Japanese line break.

rows.en: Bad luck for you!
You won't escape!
You raised a hand against the Moon... How foolish.
You dare defy this Rose C'est La Vie...!
Impossible! The Moon! The Rose C'est La Vie, so easily...!
...I was careless... It's... my loss...
No! Not me...! The Moon!
Uwooh! No... this can't be!
The moonlight... is fading...!?
The charge won't make it in time! Nngh...!
Masaki Kihara... you must be enjoying this... But I...!
So the moonlight can't reach into Heaven's embrace!?
uncertain: 'Heaven's embrace' renders ten no futokoro (inside Heaven's reach); meaning slightly uncertain.

rows.en: Ugh!? You... you're good...!
To inflict this much damage on the Rose C'est La Vie...!
So I was the one who underestimated my foe...!
Nngh... More damage than expected? Damn you, Zeorymer...!
The power of Heaven... Surely that isn't all it is!
Hmm... It seems you're still feeling me out.
I needn't even move... not for this much.
Moonlight... won't be clouded by this much.
Heh heh heh... Is that all?
Tch, is this all you are!? Zeorymer!
Why...? The power of Heaven should surpass all...
You're no longer worth the Rose C'est La Vie's time...!
Heh heh... How foolish...
Don't think an attack that weak can hit the Moon!
Is that all? How dull...
So this is... the Zeorymer I hated...!
Heh heh heh... It's useless.
Too soft! Full power!
The field of this Rose C'est La Vie... cannot be broken!
What's wrong... Can't you even touch me?
You underestimated the Rose C'est La Vie...
rows.notes: Source has a kana typo (ze for se) in the unit name; normalized.

rows.en: Damn...! The charge!
You found the Moon's blind spot... Impressive.
How careless of me...!
I will deliver the finishing blow...!
Moonlight... receive it!
Leave this to the Moon!
I won't allow it in front of me!
Race on! Like the moonlight!
Moonlight, strike down the enemy!
Take this...! Luna Flash!
Heh heh heh... Don't take the Rose C'est La Vie for just another Hakke robot...
Go! Children of the Moon!
Charge!
Fiiire!!
One of the Hakkeshu... Rockfell. Here I come!
Defying the Tekkoryu is a grave crime...!
If you stand before me... I'll defeat you!
I'll show you the power of Dinodilos of the Earth!
You met Earth... Chalk it up to bad luck and give up!
Zeorymer... I will defeat you myself!!
The traitor Kihara's bloodline ends here!!
Let's see how great the power of Heaven really is!!
Laying a hand on Earth... You reckless fool!
Intercepting!
You've made me angry...!
I'm done playing your games!
This is the end... Too bad for you.
This is my thanks. Take it!
Dinodilos of the Earth... is going down...!?
Saiga... I... end here...
N-no way... I can't believe it...!
Did I misjudge my opponent's strength!?
My spirit isn't broken yet...!
Earth will not yield yet...! Not yet!
You can shatter the Dinodilos's armor...!
I, Rockfell of the Hakkeshu... brought to this!
Against Heaven... Is it useless against Heaven...!?
Zeorymer...! Even if I die with you... I'll defeat you...!
So the real fight starts here.
Ugh!? No way, this much!?
Seems I need to steel myself.
To hold your own against Earth like this!
The Dinodilos won't fall yet!
I slipped up! I'll repay you for this!
Zeorymer... Its power is just as I expected...!
Even fallen, Heaven is still Heaven... I can't underestimate it...!
That doesn't even count as damage!
Tch, how pathetic of me!
You touched Earth. But that's all!
The Dinodilos's armor can take it!
You scratched my machine... Interesting!
Masaki Kihara... Are you toying with me...!?
Is this all Heaven's power amounts to...!?
You think something like that works on the Dinodilos!?
You really take me lightly...!
Pathetic...! Come back when you're ready!
Heaven or not, this is nothing!
No need to even dodge. How feeble.
Hmph, you can't even scratch me?
Impossible...! I'm out of energy...!?
You've opened up the distance...!
How annoying!
Dinodilos of the Earth... providing support!
I'll take the finishing blow!
Showing an opening... You fool!
I'll end it with this strike!
I won't allow it in front of Earth!
Not in front of me, Rockfell!
Leave this to Earth!
I'll settle this here.
I'll shoot you through! Take this!
Causing earthquakes isn't Earth's only power!
Maximum output! Fire!
Receive it! The wrath of the earth!
I'll sink everything into the earth!
Now I'll show you the power of the Dinodilos!
This is Earth's rumble! Savor it well!
Don't tell me... Zeorymer!?
What's going on!?
Don't get cocky!
One kill, coming right up!
So long, take care now!
As the late sages say, 'Strike first and win'!
rows.notes: Speaker inferred: Kyoshiro. Kyoshiro's maxim intro uses 'the deceased' (punning on 'the ancients'); rendered 'the late sages'.

rows.en: Heh... So you've shown up, huh?
Go get 'em, Kyoshiro!
Nana, let's go!
Woof!
rows.notes: Speaker inferred: Nana. Playful reply to q08849.

rows.en: Now, Nana! Aim for its power source!
Leave it to me!
You bastard! I'll cut you down!
Without a sword?
Curses... the blunder of Kyoshiro Yuzuki's life!
Aah, Big Brooooo!
uncertain: Nana's 'onii-chan' assumed to be Kazuya (cf. q08891, q08909, q08914); rendered 'Big Bro'.

rows.en: There's life in the jaws of death! The real fight starts now!
W-we haven't been beaten yet, you know!
H-hey! Is that even allowed!?
Nana! Eject first!
No way! I'll fight to the end too!
K-Kyoshirooo!!
It's come to this, so brace yourself!
rows.notes: Speaker inferred: Kyoshiro. Addressed to Nana.

rows.en: N-not in a place like this...!
I'm not going down!!
Not yet! Don't underestimate Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Kyaaah! A direct hit!?
L-like I'd ever lose!
Nana! Are you okay!?
I-I'm fine!
Kyoshiro, you lousy pilot!
After hearing that, I'm getting serious!
uncertain: q08872: unsure whether Kyoshiro answers Nana's jab (q08871) or the enemy; wording works for both.

rows.en: The enemy's pretty good, huh!
This is no time to be impressed!
rows.notes: Speaker inferred: Nana. Also used by Hugo and a nameless set; works generically.

rows.en: Hmph... What a lame attack.
Kyah! Nooo!
Whoops, guess I got a little careless.
Geez! Think about me for once!
Kyaaaaah!
Don't scream like that! It's just a scratch!
Hey, Kyoshiro!
Sorry, Nana.
Yay! That's Kyoshiro for you!
See? Just like I thought!
Yay! We dodged it!
Nyah nyah!
Heh... Easy.
That was pretty close, though...
How do you like that!
Nice one, Kyoshiro!
Big Bro, did you see that!?
Too bad!
Teehee. Totally A-OK!
As the late sages say, 'Be prepared and fear nothing'.
That doesn't work on us!
Useless! Nyeh!
Geez! I used up all the ammo!
Oh nooo! We're out of ammo!
Idiot! You should've kept track!
Oh no! At this rate we'll be sitting ducks!
Huh? Wh-where'd it go?
Calm down and search carefully!
Good work. Leave the rest to us!
This is Gulver, providing support!
uncertain: Unit name: glossary has 'Gulver FXII' (akurasu) while Nana's glossary entry says 'Galva FX-II'; used 'Gulver'.

rows.en: I'm here too, you know!
Never let your guard down!
Careless for a second, crippled for life!
Kazuya! Leave the rest to me!
Big Bro, I'm coming too!
You're such a handful!
Please, hurry and get away!
Leave it to Nana!
I'm coming to help!
Look out! Big Bro!
Here we go!
Let's go, Daimos!
You're in my range now!
I'm betting everything on this strike!
Gwaaaaaaah!!
Gwah!! At this rate I'll be beaten!?
Uwoh!! I can't go down yet!!
D-damn it! What just happened!?
If it's come to this, I'll just have to steel myself!!
Don't flinch, Daimos! The real fight starts now!!
Erika...! Lend me your strength!!
Gwah! You'll pay for that!
I'm not gonna croak that easily!
Ngh! I'm not about to whine!
You're not strong enough to beat Daimos yet!
For Erika's sake too, I can't lose here!
What's wrong! You're short on fighting spirit!
Ngh! This is nothing!
Oops, guess that one hit me.
Way too soft!
Don't underestimate me and Daimos!
Not yet! Come at me again!
You think that'll stop me!?
Close! Missed me by a hair.
Like I'd get hit!
Piece of cake!
Don't underestimate Daimos's footwork!
Whoa, that was close!
Whoa there!
Too soft! Come back when you're ready!
How's that for footwork!
Bring it on! Daimos will take you on!
A beam like this is nothing!
Ngh! I can't attack!
No good! It's too far!
Damn, they got out of my reach!
Ngh...! Careless of me!
Whoa! Don't forget I'm here too!
I won't let your attack go to waste!
Kyoshiro! Leave the finish to me!
Leave this to Daimos!
I'll take over this fight!
Hold it! I'll be your opponent!
Nana! Don't do anything reckless!
Let's go all out!
Double! Dragon! Blade!
Hoataaah!!
Fiiiive Shooteeeer!!
Daiiimos Shaaaft!!
Triple! Dragon! Staff!!
Teyaaah!
Sooryaaah!
Double Blizzaaaaard!!
Daimos Kiiiiiick!!
Gale! Daimos Kiiiick!!
Deadly!! Gale!! Correct Fiiiist Thruuuust!!
Gale Correct Fist Thruuuuust!!
Freezer Stoooorm!!
Fiiiire Blizzaaaard!!
Here I go!
This should do it!
Ngh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaah! The controls!?
Ngh... This is a tough opponent!
I can't go down yet!
Oh no! I've taken damage!!
Not yet! I can handle this much!
Ngh! I couldn't dodge it!
Not from something like this!!
This is just a scratch!
This much is nothing serious!
That didn't hurt!
I'm fine, this is nothing!
I can't afford to get hit!
I can dodge something like this!
Th-that was close!
It's useless!
That won't work on me!
I can't counterattack!!
Ngh, it's out of range...
Leave this to me!
I won't let you get in the way!
Launching missiles!
